items.title: Thailand Wants 1.5 Million U.S. Tourists — It’s Got a Long Way to Go
items.summary: Thailand is chasing higher-spending Americans, but arrivals will need to accelerate sharply to hit its 1.5 million target. Expensive flights and growing competition from Japan and Vietnam won't make that any easier.

items.title: Accor Is Betting on Asia. Just Not the Same Way Everywhere
items.summary: Accor clearly wants to grow in Asia. It just doesn’t want to do it the same way everywhere.

items.title: Barry Diller Withdraws MGM Resorts Bid Worth $18 Billion
items.summary: People Inc. walked back its takeover bid but emphasized confidence in MGM, with Barry Diller open to a “range of alternatives.”

items.title: Brian Chesky Commits to Launching an AI Agent in 2027
items.summary: Airbnb has talked for years about becoming an AI concierge. Now Brian Chesky has put a 2027 date on it — and he says the interface won’t look like a typical chatbot.

items.title: Agentic AI Is Raising Travel’s Tech Bill
items.summary: Amadeus and Spotnana agree the plumbing for AI-powered travel costs more now. The industry still hasn’t settled who pays — or who captures the value.

items.title: Prince Harry Calls on Travel Industry to Put Destinations First
items.summary: The Duke of Sussex and founder of Travalyst wants the travel industry to prioritize the health and value of the people and places it sells — because business success relies on the longevity of those destinations.

items.title: Booking Holdings: Building a Long-Term Competitive Advantage
items.summary: Incumbent brands have to ask themselves:  if the technology gets democratized, what do we have that no one else can replicate?

items.title: Understanding AI’s Broad Impact
items.summary: Travel brands have to evaluate if they're structured to let an agent handle the full relationship, and whether internal divisions may hold them back.
